reason: This plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness notification/monitoring plugin: it listens to task events and confirmation flows, then sends templated alerts via configurable HTTP webhook, A2A, MCP, and optional Windows SAPI channels. The repository and manifest explicitly position it as an event-to-notify bridge for task status, human confirmation, escalation, and optional proactive model messages, which is consistent with a notifications-monitoring purpose.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 任务发生结束、人工确认请求或超时升级时进行提醒，可通过配置的 HTTP/Webhook、A2A、MCP 或 Windows SAPI 声音渠道发送通知，并可选启用模型主动消息通知。
summaries.en: This plugin provides DeepSeek Harness task notifications by alerting on turn end, approval requests, and escalation events through configurable HTTP webhooks, A2A, MCP, or optional Windows SAPI voice channels, with an optional model-initiated notify action.

capabilities: Listens for DeepSeek Harness task lifecycle events (turn/end, approval/ask, timeout)
Sends outbound HTTP webhook notifications with configurable payload templates
Posts outbound A2A JSON-RPC message/send notifications
Invokes MCP streamable-HTTP tool calls as a notification bridge
Optionally triggers local Windows SAPI voice output via PowerShell
Can expose a model-initiated notify tool for proactive messages
Supports env/credential-based secret injection for endpoint configuration

reasons.code: External outbound notification delivery to user-configured URLs/channels introduces runtime network exposure.
Model-initiated notify tool is supported and marked explicit-content, allowing model to send arbitrary messages through all enabled channels.
Optional Windows SAPI path executes a PowerShell-based speech process, introducing local process execution behavior.
